name: Ore-tachi ni Tsubasa wa Nai AfterStory
original_name: 俺たちに翼はない AfterStory
source:
This Oretsuba fandisk has after stories for each of the 4 heroines, plus over 20 short-stories, a new OP and ED, as well as character songs and a tachi-e and scenery viewer. Also, the protagonists will be voiced except during H scenes!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这部《我们没有翅膀》Fan Disc收录了四名女主角各自的后日谈、二十多篇短篇故事、全新的片头曲与片尾曲，以及角色歌曲、立绘和背景鉴赏功能。此外，除H场景外，各位主人公也将拥有配音！

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
